alexa (docs): Starting a tiny coordination thread for a compact section I'm adding to the Rate & Quota docs: need a short Py + TS snippet that checks quota, a small note about header names across deployments, and a fallback pattern if /quota isn't reachable. PR: https://rwd/pulls/5992

rafael (sdk): Quick facts: hosted -> X-Quota-Org; private -> X-Tenant-Quota. Recommend primary pattern: call /quota (preferred) then fall back to checking headers. Meter v2 deprecates X-Rate-Limit-Remaining.

priyanka (product): For the burst credits blurb: one sentence + an illustrative tiny table (Tier | Sample monthly quota | Example burst credits). Keep it explicit that numbers are samples, not contractual.

alexa (docs): Draft Python snippet I put in the PR (very compact):

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
q = c.quota.get()
print(q.tokens_left, q.requests_left)
if q.requests_left > 0:
  r = c.generate(model="rw-medium", prompt="hello")
  print(r.id, r.quota_left)
```

theo (analytics): Add a one-line troubleshooting note: "tokens != requests" 12; background embedding/ingest jobs can consume tokens without incrementing request count. Showing both fields reduces tickets.

rafael (sdk): Tiny edits: use snake_case fields (already in snippet), show basic error handling in examples. Also add a 1-liner fallback: `headers.get('x-quota-org') or headers.get('x-tenant-quota')` if /quota fails.

alexa (docs): Good. CI flagged the grafana link so I'll attach a sanitized screenshot instead of a live internal panel. screenshot-bot, can you add the artifact to the PR?

screenshot-bot: Attached sanitized PNG to PR. Note: internal panel IDs vary by deployment; use permalinks for private embeds.

priyanka (product): +1. Please add a short migration checklist at the top: 1) audit header usage 2) update to /quota or new headers 3) validate dashboards.

alexa (docs): Added checklist and the illustrative table. If everyone can react with :white_check_mark: after a quick review I'll merge once CI is green and the PNG is present.
